If you are not an EU or EEA citizen, you usually need a work permit before you move. Your employer starts the application.
Registering with the Tax Agency gives you a personal identity number. Most services ask for it.
Once you have a personal identity number, you can apply for a Swedish ID card at the Tax Agency.
Your salary is paid into a Swedish bank account. Ask the bank what they need to see.
BankID is the digital ID most services in Sweden use to log in. You get it from your bank.
Choose a health centre near where you live. 1177 explains how health care works in your region.
The Social Insurance Agency handles things like sick pay and parental benefit. Check what applies to you.
Swedish for immigrants (SFI) is free. You apply through the municipality where you live.
A licence from outside the EU or EEA can only be used for a limited time. The Transport Agency explains how to exchange it.
